ledger.claim: Large packuments coexist with serialized cache buffer
ledger.evidence: DHAT attributed 32.398 MiB to a cache Vec. The original admission regression serialized before budget reservation. The contiguous writer reserves initial capacity and both old and replacement capacity before growth, and retains reservations through queued writes. The chunk representation was rejected. The contiguous micro measured 71.57 to 72.94 ms. Eight final plain T3 pairs measured 2356 to 2211.5 ms; the readiness comparator flagged Nest and Vite tails. These measurements do not establish a general wall-time or RSS improvement. The retained benefit is enforcement of the serialization allocation budget. A balanced three-binary replay measured original #862 2368 ms, current #862 2356.5 ms, and the cache candidate 2435.5 ms. The earlier candidate median was not a repeatable speed win.

base = pathlib.Path("/tmp/lpm-latest-metadata/shipping-first")
